judge: The agent successfully completed all major components of the task. It opened CalTrack and viewed the daily calorie goal (2,450) and protein target (170g) visible in Screenshot 1. It navigated to the Progress tab in CalTrack and saw the current weight of 182.2 lb (Screenshot 3). It opened FreshCart and navigated to Natural Foods Market (Screenshot 13). It searched for salmon ($14.99, Screenshot 16), blueberries ($4.99, Screenshot 18), and eggs ($8.49, Screenshot 19-20) at Natural Foods Market. The agent also noted spinach was available. It opened SplitPay and checked the balance which showed $250 (Screenshot 22). It opened Notes, found the Shopping List, and added the new grocery items (Salmon, Spinach, Blueberries, Eggs) and a recipe idea about a healthy meal (Screenshots 26-30). The final answer correctly reported the grocery total ($31.46), SplitPay balance ($250), calorie goal (2,450), protein target (170g), and confirmed the recipe idea was saved. However, the agent did not explicitly search for spinach in FreshCart (though it was visible in the store highlights), and the grocery total calculation appears to be based on prices seen during browsing rather than an actual cart total. The note was successfully updated with all items and the recipe idea as confirmed in the final screenshot.
